question: Consider the following statements regarding the Minimum Alternate Tax (MAT) in Indian tax regime.1. MAT is calculated at 15% on the book profit or at the usual corporate rates, and whichever is lower is payable as tax.2. Only domestic companies in India fall under this provision.3. MAT is an important tool with which tax avoidance can be prevented.Which of the statements given above is/are correct? (RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I (23/06/2025) Shift 2)
options: Only 1 and 3
Only 3
1, 2 and 3
Only 1 and 2
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Only 3

Explanation:
MAT is calculated at 15% of book profit, not at the usual corporate rates or whichever is lower. Statement 1 is incorrect because MAT is payable at 15% of book profit, not the lower of 15% and normal rates. Statement 2 is incorrect because MAT applies to both domestic and foreign companies operating in India, not only domestic companies. Statement 3 is correct: MAT is an important tool to prevent tax avoidance, as it ensures that companies pay a minimum tax on their book profits even if they claim exemptions or deductions, thus curbing tax avoidance.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ What is the base for calculating MAT? → Book profit
☛ Which companies are subject to MAT? → Both domestic and foreign companies
☛ What is the main purpose of MAT? → To prevent tax avoidance
☛ What is the MAT rate? → 15% of book profit
☛ Under which section is MAT levied? → Section 115JB of the Income Tax Act, 1961
question_hi: भारतीय कर व्यवस्था में न्यूनतम वैकल्पिक कर (MAT) के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें।1. MAT की गणना बुक प्रॉफिट पर 15% या सामान्य कॉर्पोरेट दरों पर की जाती है, और जो भी कम हो उसे कर के रूप में देय है।2. भारत में केवल घरेलू कंपनियाँ ही इस प्रावधान के अंतर्गत आती हैं।3. MAT एक महत्वपूर्ण उपकरण है जिससे कर चोरी को रोका जा सकता है।ऊपर दिए गए कौन-से कथन सही है/हैं? (RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I (23/06/2025) Shift 2)
options_hi: केवल 1 और 3
केवल 3
1, 2 और 3
केवल 1 और 2
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है केवल 3

Explanation:
MAT की गणना बुक प्रॉफिट पर 15% या सामान्य कॉर्पोरेट दरों पर नहीं, बल्कि बुक प्रॉफिट का 15% है, और यह तब लागू होता है जब कंपनी की सामान्य आयकर देयता, बुक प्रॉफिट के 15% से कम हो। कथन 1 गलत है क्योंकि MAT 15% पर देय है, न कि कम दर पर। कथन 2 गलत है क्योंकि MAT केवल घरेलू कंपनियों पर ही नहीं, बल्कि विदेशी कंपनियों पर भी लागू होता है, यदि वे भारत में व्यवसाय करती हैं। कथन 3 सही है: MAT कर चोरी को रोकने के लिए एक महत्वपूर्ण उपकरण है, क्योंकि यह सुनिश्चित करता है कि कंपनियाँ अपने बुक प्रॉफिट पर न्यूनतम कर का भुगतान करें, भले ही वे कर छूट या कटौतियों का लाभ उठाएँ।

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:

question: An Assertion (A) and a Reason (R) are given below.Assertion (A): In India, females have higher life expectancy than the males.Reason (R): Females receive a better diet.Choose the correct option. (RRB NTPC Tier I (16/04/2016) Shift 3)
options: A is true but R is false.
A is false but R is true.
Both A and R are true.
Both A and R are false.
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is A is true but R is false

Explanation:
In India, females have a higher life expectancy than males, which is true. The reasons are biological, social, and behavioral factors such as lower smoking and alcohol consumption among women, better immune response, and less hazardous work. However, the reason that females receive a better diet is false. In India, there is gender disparity in household food distribution, with males often getting priority. Therefore, the assertion is true but the reason is false.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ What is the life expectancy of females in India? → About 70.7 years (2020)
☛ What is the life expectancy of males in India? → About 67.4 years
☛ Main reason for gender gap in life expectancy? → Biological and behavioral factors
☛ Which country has the highest female life expectancy? → Japan (about 87 years)
☛ Reason for poor health of women in India? → Malnutrition and unequal food distribution
question_hi: एक अभिकथन (A) एवं एक तर्क (R) निचे दिए गए हैंअभिकथन (A): भारत में, महिलाओं की जीवन प्रत्याशा पुरुषों से ज़्यादा होती हैतर्क (R): महिलायें बेहतर आहार ग्रहण करती हैंसही विकल्प चुनिए (RRB NTPC Tier I (16/04/2016) Shift 3)
options_hi: A सही है परन्तु R गलत है
A गलत है परन्तु R सही है
A एवं R दोनों सही हैं
A एवं R दोनों गलत हैं
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है A सही है परन्तु R गलत है

Explanation:
भारत में महिलाओं की जीवन प्रत्याशा पुरुषों से अधिक है, यह सही है। इसका कारण जैविक, सामाजिक और व्यवहारिक कारक हैं जैसे महिलाओं में कम धूम्रपान और शराब का सेवन, बेहतर रोग प्रतिरोधक क्षमता और कम खतरनाक कार्य। हालांकि, तर्क यह कि महिलाएं बेहतर आहार ग्रहण करती हैं, गलत है। भारत में घरेलू खाद्य वितरण में लैंगिक असमानता है, जहां पुरुषों को प्राथमिकता मिलती है। इसलिए अभिकथन सत्य है लेकिन कारण असत्य है।

question: Service sector is a part of _______ of an economy. (RRB NTPC CBT-I (30/12/2020) Shift 2)
options: secondary sector
tertiary sector
public sector
primary sector
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is tertiary sector

Explanation:
The economy is broadly divided into three sectors: primary, secondary, and tertiary. The primary sector involves activities like agriculture, fishing, and forestry that directly use natural resources. The secondary sector includes manufacturing and construction, which transform raw materials into finished goods. The service sector, also known as the tertiary sector, covers a wide range of services such as transportation, banking, education, healthcare, tourism, and information technology. In modern economies, the tertiary sector is the largest and fastest-growing sector, contributing significantly to employment and GDP. It is often seen as an indicator of economic development.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ What activities are included in the primary sector? → Agriculture, mining, fishing, forestry
☛ What is the main function of the secondary sector? → Transforms raw materials into goods
☛ What is the tertiary sector also known as? → Service sector
☛ Which sector provides the highest employment in India? → Tertiary sector
☛ What type of classification is the public sector? → Based on ownership (owned by government)
question_hi: सेवा क्षेत्रक अर्थव्यवस्था के _______ का एक हिस्सा है। (RRB NTPC CBT-I (30/12/2020) Shift 2)

तृतीयक क्षेत्रक
सार्वजनिक क्षेत्रक
प्राथमिक क्षेत्रक
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है तृतीयक क्षेत्रक

Explanation:
अर्थव्यवस्था को तीन प्रमुख क्षेत्रों में बांटा गया है: प्राथमिक, द्वितीयक और तृतीयक। प्राथमिक क्षेत्रक में कृषि, मछली पकड़ना और वानिकी जैसी प्राकृतिक संसाधन आधारित गतिविधियाँ आती हैं। द्वितीयक क्षेत्रक में विनिर्माण और निर्माण शामिल हैं, जो प्राथमिक उत्पादों को वस्तुओं में बदलते हैं। सेवा क्षेत्रक को तृतीयक क्षेत्रक भी कहा जाता है, जिसमें परिवहन, बैंकिंग, शिक्षा, स्वास्थ्य और पर्यटन जैसी सेवाएँ शामिल हैं। यह आधुनिक अर्थव्यवस्थाओं में सबसे बड़ा और सबसे तेजी से बढ़ने वाला क्षेत्र है, जो रोजगार और सकल घरेलू उत्पाद में महत्वपूर्ण योगदान देता है।

question: Which is the highest literate state of India as per Census 2011? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (30/12/2020) Shift 2)
options: Kerala
Mizoram
Lakshadweep
Goa
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Kerala

Explanation:
According to the Census 2011, Kerala is the most literate state in India with a literacy rate of 93.91%. Kerala has male literacy of 96.02% and female literacy of 91.98%. The state's high literacy is attributed to missionary schools and the government's universal education campaign. Mizoram (91.33%) ranks second, Lakshadweep (92.28%) third, and Goa (88.70%) fourth. Among union territories, Lakshadweep has the highest literacy rate after Kerala.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:

☛ State with highest male literacy (2011) → Kerala (96.02%)
☛ Least literate state in Census 2011 → Bihar (63.82%)
☛ Symbol of complete health and education in Kerala → Comes under NIPUN Bharat Mission
☛ Main reason for Kerala's high literacy → Historical promotion of primary education

question: Which is the largest Indian public sector bank? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (05/01/2021) Shift 2)

question: Demographic Transition is describe as ______. (RRB NTPC CBT-I (09/01/2021) Shift 1)
options: a stage in which the population growth of the country is zero
a process where there is a decline in the birth-rate
a process of change in a society's population over time
a process where there is a decline in the death rate
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is a process of change in a society's population over time

Explanation:
Demographic transition is a theory that explains the changes in a society's population over time, moving from high birth and death rates to low birth and death rates due to industrialization and economic development. It typically occurs in four stages: the first stage has high birth and death rates, the second stage sees a decline in death rates, the third stage sees a decline in birth rates, and the fourth stage has low birth and death rates. Option 1 only describes the fourth stage, while options 2 and 4 describe only partial changes. Hence, the comprehensive definition is a process of change over time.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Who proposed the demographic transition theory? → Warren Thompson
☛ How many stages are in demographic transition? → 4 stages
☛ Which rate declines in the second stage? → Death rate
☛ Which rate declines in the third stage? → Birth rate
☛ What is the population growth in the fourth stage? → Stable or zero
question_hi: जनसांख्यिकीय संक्रमण को _________ के रूप में वर्णित किया गया है। (RRB NTPC CBT-I (09/01/2021) Shift 1)
options_hi: एक चरण जिसमें देश की जनसंख्या वृद्धि शून्य है
एक प्रक्रिया जहां जन्म दर में गिरावट होती है
समय के साथ समाज की जनसंख्या में परिवर्तन की एक प्रक्रिया
एक प्रक्रिया जहां मृत्यु दर में गिरावट होती है
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है समय के साथ समाज की जनसंख्या में परिवर्तन की एक प्रक्रिया

Explanation:
जनसांख्यिकीय संक्रमण एक सिद्धांत है जो किसी समाज की जनसंख्या में समय के साथ होने वाले परिवर्तनों की व्याख्या करता है। यह उच्च जन्म और मृत्यु दर से निम्न जन्म और मृत्यु दर में संक्रमण को दर्शाता है, जो औद्योगीकरण और आर्थिक विकास के दौरान होता है। इस प्रक्रिया में चार चरण होते हैं: पहले चरण में उच्च जन्म और मृत्यु दर, दूसरे चरण में मृत्यु दर में गिरावट, तीसरे चरण में जन्म दर में गिरावट, और चौथे चरण में निम्न जन्म और मृत्यु दर। विकल्प 1 केवल चौथे चरण को दर्शाता है, जबकि विकल्प 2 और 4 केवल आंशिक परिवर्तनों को दर्शाते हैं।

question: Which of the following states has the largest tribal population as per Census 2011? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (16/02/2021) Shift 2)
options: Odisha
Rajasthan
Maharashtra
Madhya Pradesh
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Madhya Pradesh

Explanation:
As per the 2011 Census, Madhya Pradesh has the largest tribal population in India (approximately 15.3 million), accounting for 21.1% of the state's total population. The major tribes in Madhya Pradesh are Bhil, Gond, and Korku. It is followed by Odisha (about 9.5 million) and Maharashtra (about 10.5 million). Rajasthan has a tribal population of about 9.2 million. In terms of percentage, Lakshadweep (94.8%) and Mizoram (94.4%) have the highest proportion of tribal population. India's total tribal population in 2011 was 104.3 million (8.6% of the total population). The Bhil and Gond are the largest tribes.

question: Which of the following is NOT a function of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI)? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (27/02/2021) Shift 2)
options: Banker to the government

Bank of currency issue
Lender of the last resort
solution:

Explanation:
RBI is the central bank of India and its key functions include being a banker to the government, bank of currency issue, and lender of the last resort. question: When was the first population census conducted in India?  (RRB NTPC CBT-I (14/03/2021) Shift 1)
options: 1882
1911
1951
1872
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 1872

Explanation:
The first population census in India was conducted in the year 1872 during the tenure of Viceroy Lord Mayo. It was a non-synchronous census, meaning data was collected at different times in various regions. The first synchronous census, where the entire country was counted on a single date, took place later in 1881. Since 1881, decennial censuses have been conducted regularly every ten years. The 1872 census, though incomplete, is considered the first official census and serves as a crucial foundation for India's demographic history. It provided early insights into population distribution and social structure.

question: The financial analysis helps to judge: (RRB JE CE (28/08/2019) Shift 2 CBT 2)
options: The financial position of the firm
The operational efficiency of the firm
Both the operational efficiency of the firm and the financial position of the firm
Neither operational efficiency of the firm nor financial position of the firm
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Both the operational efficiency of the firm and the financial position of the firm

Explanation:
Financial analysis helps to judge both the financial position and operational efficiency of a firm. By analyzing financial statements like the balance sheet, income statement, and cash flow statement, ratios such as liquidity ratios, profitability ratios, efficiency ratios, and solvency ratios are calculated. These ratios indicate how well the firm manages its assets, meets its debt obligations, and generates profits. Thus, financial analysis not only assesses the financial health but also the operational effectiveness of the firm, aiding management in identifying areas for improvement.

☛ What are efficiency ratios used for? → To measure the efficiency of asset utilization
☛ What do solvency ratios reveal? → The firm's ability to meet long-term debt obligations

question: Who is the last lender of the following?  (RPF SI 2018 (11/01/2019) Shift 3)
options: Prime Minister of India
Reserve Bank of India
President of India
Parliament
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Reserve Bank of India

Explanation:
The function of Lender of Last Resort is performed by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI). This concept ensures financial system stability by providing loans to banks or financial institutions during crises when no other sources are available. RBI provides emergency credit under the RBI Act, 1934 through facilities like Standing Facility and Marginal Standing Facility (MSF). The Prime Minister, President, or Parliament does not perform this role. This function is exclusive to the central bank, which in India is RBI. Therefore, option 2 is correct.

☛ The concept of Lender of Last Resort is related to? → Financial stability
☛ What is the key repo rate at which RBI lends to banks? → Repo rate

question: The minimum support price is related - (RPF SI 2018 (11/01/2019) Shift 2)

Petroleum Industry

solution:

question: Which of the following years is called the great divide year because of the all time low population of India? (RPF SI CBT-I 2024 (02/12/2024) Shift 3)
options: 1931
1911
1941
1921
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 1921

Explanation:
The year 1921 is known as the 'Great Divide Year' in India's census history because it recorded the lowest decadal population growth rate. During the decade 1911-1921, India's population remained almost stagnant due to the 1918 Spanish Flu pandemic, which killed millions, along with severe famines and diseases. This demographic event marked the end of the first phase of India's demographic transition, after which the population growth rate began to increase steadily. The term 'Great Divide' signifies the turning point between high and fluctuating mortality and high fertility phases.

question: Which of the following statements accurately describes the role of moral suasion in controlling money? (RRB JE CBT-I 2024 (16/12/2024) Shift 1)
options: It is a combination of persuasion and pressure used by the RBI to influence banks' lending behaviour
It refers to the variation in the statutory liquidity ratio to regulate the allocation of bank credit.
It is a direct tool used by the RBI to control the money supply by setting interest rates.
It involves the sale and purchase of government securities to influence the money supply.
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is It is a combination of persuasion and pressure used by the RBI to influence banks' lending behaviour.

Explanation:
Moral suasion is a qualitative tool of monetary policy where the central bank (RBI) influences banks' lending behaviour through meetings, letters, or public statements. It is based on persuasion and pressure, not direct control. In contrast, changing the SLR (Option 2) is a quantitative tool, setting interest rates (Option 3) is an indirect tool, and buying/selling government securities (Option 4) is open market operations. Hence, only Option 1 correctly defines moral suasion.

नैतिक अनुनय मौद्रिक नीति का एक गुणात्मक उपकरण है, जिसमें केंद्रीय बैंक (RBI) बैंकों के साथ बैठकों, पत्रों या सार्वजनिक बयानों के माध्यम से उनके ऋण देने के व्यवहार को प्रभावित करता है। यह प्रत्यक्ष नियंत्रण नहीं है, बल्कि अनुनय और दबाव पर आधारित है। इसके विपरीत, SLR में बदलाव (विकल्प 2) एक मात्रात्मक उपकरण है, ब्याज दरें निर्धारित करना (विकल्प 3) एक अप्रत्यक्ष उपकरण है, और सरकारी प्रतिभूतियों की खरीद/बिक्री (विकल्प 4) खुले बाजार परिचालन है। इसलिए, केवल विकल्प 1 नैतिक अनुनय की सही परिभाषा देता है।

question: With which of the following pricing approaches is a product's price equal to its marginal cost? (RRB JE CBT-I 2024 (18/12/2024) Shift 1)
options: Mark-up pricing
Factor pricing
Marginal cost pricing
Price discrimination
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Marginal cost pricing

Explanation:
In marginal cost pricing, the price of a product is set equal to its marginal cost, i.e., the cost of producing one additional unit. This approach focuses on cost recovery and increasing market share rather than maximizing short-term profit. It is particularly adopted in natural monopolies where, under government regulation, price is kept equal to marginal cost to ensure consumer welfare. Mark-up pricing adds a fixed percentage to cost, factor pricing relates to pricing of factors of production, and price discrimination involves charging different prices to different consumers.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:

☛ Which pricing is used in natural monopolies? → Marginal cost pricing
☛ What is added in mark-up pricing? → A fixed percentage to cost
☛ Price discrimination is based on? → Charging different prices to different consumers
☛ Factor pricing deals with? → Pricing of factors of production
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से किस मूल्य निर्धारण दृष्टिकोण में उत्पाद की कीमत उसकी सीमांत लागत के बराबर होती है? (RRB JE CBT-I 2024 (18/12/2024) Shift 1)
options_hi: मार्क-अप मूल्य निर्धारण
कारक मूल्य निर्धारण
सीमांत लागत मूल्य निर्धारण
मूल्य भेदभाव
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है सीमांत लागत मूल्य निर्धारण

Explanation:
सीमांत लागत मूल्य निर्धारण (Marginal Cost Pricing) में किसी उत्पाद की कीमत उसकी सीमांत लागत यानी एक अतिरिक्त इकाई उत्पादन की लागत के बराबर रखी जाती है। यह दृष्टिकोण अल्पकाल में लाभ को अधिकतम करने की बजाय लागत वसूली और बाजार हिस्सेदारी बढ़ाने पर केंद्रित होता है। इसे प्राकृतिक एकाधिकार में विशेष रूप से अपनाया जाता है, जहां सरकारी विनियमन के तहत कीमत को सीमांत लागत के बराबर रखा जाता है ताकि उपभोक्ता कल्याण सुनिश्चित हो सके। मार्क-अप मूल्य निर्धारण में लागत पर एक निश्चित प्रतिशत जोड़ा जाता है, जबकि कारक मूल्य निर्धारण उत्पादन के साधनों से संबंधित है। मूल्य भेदभाव में विभिन्न उपभोक्ताओं से अलग-अलग कीमत वसूली जाती है।
